Synonym of survivor guilt.
A woman or girl who survives.
insurance paid to surviving spouses
The state of being a survivor.
The number or percentage of young that survive to adulthood.
A right whereby a person becomes entitled to property by reason of his having survived another person who had an interest in it. It is one of the elements of a joint tenancy.
an annuity payable to one person in the event that someone else is unable to receive it
A form of selection bias in which only the people or things that "survived" some process are considered, while those that did not are inadvertently overlooked because of their lack of visibility.
